title: nan
authors: Zhou J.; Mao K.; Wang R.; He T.; Huang L.
key_contribution: Proposes a multi-sensor fusion autonomous navigation method for indoor UAVs in GPS-denied substations using laser SLAM and AprilTag relocation with Dijkstra/DWA path planning.
